title: Fox holding a heart
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- fox body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="22" ry="20" fill="#E8651A"/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="16" ry="14" fill="#F2893D"/>
  <!-- chest -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="11" ry="12" fill="#FFE8D6"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="44" rx="20" ry="17" fill="#E8651A"/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="15" ry="12" fill="#F2893D"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points="32,32 26,12 42,26" fill="#E8651A"/>
  <polygon points="68,32 74,12 58,26" fill="#E8651A"/>
  <!-- inner ears -->
  <polygon points="34,30 30,18 40,27" fill="#FFB3A0"/>
  <polygon points="66,30 70,18 60,27" fill="#FFB3A0"/>
  <!-- face white patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="14" ry="11" fill="#FFE8D6"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="42" rx="3" ry="3.5" fill="#3D1F0F"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="42" rx="3" ry="3.5" fill="#3D1F0F"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="41" r="1.2" fill="#FFD9B0"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="41" r="1.2" fill="#FFD9B0"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="49" rx="3" ry="2.2" fill="#3D1F0F"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M46,52 Q50,55 54,52" stroke="#3D1F0F" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- arms holding heart -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="62" rx="6" ry="4.5" fill="#E8651A" transform="rotate(-20 34 62)"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="62" rx="6" ry="4.5" fill="#E8651A" transform="rotate(20 66 62)"/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="59" r="4" fill="#FFE8D6"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="59" r="4" fill="#FFE8D6"/>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d="M50,68 C50,68 40,58 40,52 C40,47 44,45 47,45 C49,45 50,47 50,48 C50,47 51,45 53,45 C56,45 60,47 60,52 C60,58 50,68 50,68 Z" fill="#E8253D"/>
  <!-- heart highlight -->
  <path d="M45,50 C45,48 46,47 48,47" stroke="#FF8FA0" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="91" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#C94E10"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="91" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#C94E10"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M70,80 Q85,70 82,55 Q80,48 74,52 Q78,60 72,72 Z" fill="#E8651A"/>
  <path d="M78,55 Q80,52 76,54 Q75,58 75,62" fill="#FFE8D6"/>
</svg>
